scenarios.name: casting-a-colorless-creature-manifests-the-top-card
scenarios.why: Casting Memnite (a colorless creature spell) manifests the top library card: the Grizzly Bears move onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature.

scenarios.name: manifested-card-is-never-offered-turn-face-up
scenarios.why: A manifested creature card may be turned face up any time for its mana cost; the engine's turn-face-up special action covers only the morph family, so no turn-face-up option is offered for the manifested Grizzly Bears.
